programs.name: Brass Swell I
programs.description: The classic swell: the VCF EG rises from IL to AL over half a second, then pressure adds brilliance. Lean into held chords.

programs.name: Brass Swell II
programs.description: 16' and 8' ranks swell together over 0.8 s with more resonance in the bloom; pressure brightens further.

programs.name: Pressure Swell Brass
programs.description: Hardly any envelope sweep: the brightness and loudness are almost entirely under after touch. Press to swell, ease off to fall back.

programs.name: Resonant Swell Brass
programs.description: Higher RESONANCE so a peak travels up the spectrum as the VCF EG climbs to AL.

programs.name: Noir Swell Brass
programs.description: Cinematic film-score brass: wide detune, slow filter bloom, deep after-touch brilliance and pressure vibrato from the SUB oscillator.

programs.name: Sforzando Brass
programs.description: A fast VCF EG attack to a high AL then a quick decay to a darker sustain: the sharp accent then hold of an orchestral sfz.

programs.name: Brass Stab
programs.description: Short, punchy section stab: instant VCA, short VCF EG and a fast release. Velocity sets the bite.

programs.name: Horn Section
programs.description: Saw on rank I against a narrow pulse on rank II, a soft attack and a low cutoff for a mellow horn section.

programs.name: Covered Horn
programs.description: Round, covered horn: low cutoff, little resonance, a slower attack and after-touch level for phrasing.

programs.name: Muted Trumpet
programs.description: High-passed and resonant, like a cup mute; a narrow pulse on rank II adds the nasal edge.

programs.name: Trombone Glide

programs.name: Fanfare Brass

programs.name: Brass Ensemble 16

programs.name: Low Brass

programs.name: Fifth Brass

programs.name: Wah Brass
